items.title: Eddie Metz Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 3, 2015
items.q: James Taylor, Steely Dan, Eric Clapton, he’s doing all these gigs. He’s like Steve Gadd’s sub.

ctx.x: And he was playing drums with them. He was just a country boy from Mississippi. James Taylor, Steely Dan, Eric Clapton, he’s doing all these gigs. He’s like Steve Gadd’s sub. What a position that is to be in. And maybe if I’d stuck around New York I could have done more stuff like that or I could be on Broadway. A lot of my friends, John Allred, the greatest trombone player I know, is in New York playing on Broadway, sitting in the pit. Making good money. Making good pension. Not having to be on the road. That’s a
blessing these days, not having to deal with airports and airlines and stuff. I’m not sick of it yet.
